'''Bandy Geffer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[New Jedi Order]]. He was at the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] when [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors hired by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|raided the temple]]. During the fight, Geffer assisted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Raynar Thul]] in subduing five Mandalorians.<ref name="Backlash" />

Later, Bandy participated in the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|rescue attempt]] of [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]]. He and Jedi Knight [[Doran Sarkin-Tainer]] piloted an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] disguised as a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] vehicle to help extract "Team Saav'etu", "Team Solo", and the Horn siblings. After he was one of four Jedi assigned to a post on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] until the anti-slavery rebels achieved their independence, the other three being Jedi Master [[Kyp Durron]], Jedi Knight [[Sothais Saar]], and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|Youngling]] [[Raharra Lapti]].<ref name="Backlash" />
